notes: V30.42 makes dense geometry conservative and final-pose consistent: MVS depths are photometrically revalidated after pose optimization; raw dense worker splats/meshes remain candidate-only; RGB validation uses an independent robust reprojection metric and withholds committed geometry when RGB consensus collapses; RGB submap edges no longer fabricate translation from their own prior; surface confirmation requires explicit independent support; and global multi-layer meshing uses conflict coloring instead of connected components, preserving disconnected compatible surfels.
